steps.what: Direct investigation of suspected arson, hazards and false alarms
Draft reports outlining verified investigation findings and unresolved questions

loop.purpose: Arrange verified findings into a report narrative
loop.input: Supervisor-confirmed findings with source references and explicit uncertainty
loop.check: Supervisor checks chronology, attribution, evidential limits and every causal claim against originals
loop.stop: One revision; ambiguous attribution or unsupported conclusions return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates provide headings but narrative must convey case-specific findings and uncertainty

steps.what: Review the exact findings report and submit it to the authorised recipient

tasks.design: Retain investigation direction in {OPS_SYSTEM} and test native {DOCS} report templates first. A bounded loop may draft from confirmed findings, but cannot infer causes, classify suspects or close unresolved questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Investigation findings need careful narrative assembly after evidence review.
tasks.enabler_now: Constrained drafting can use a supervisor-confirmed source pack.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent narrative may hide uncertainty or change attribution.
tasks.human_edge: Direct investigation and distinguish findings from speculation.
tasks.altitude: Potentially less report drafting; investigation authority remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Anchorage's police drafting trial found review consumed expected time savings; it does not demonstrate a fire-investigation saving.
The proposed investigation-report drafting reduction is an E1 scenario with retained evidence review.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor investigation direction and findings report, excluding investigators' field labour. Allocate this report here rather than generic administration.

Investigators retain existing evidence capture. Supervisor produces confirmed findings, source references, chronology and unresolved questions in s1's full65 hours; missing facts require manual verification.
Source-pack preparation remains in s1; narrative correction15 hours and final review10 hours are retained. No model generates new evidence.
Use native templates first and only a permitted drafting environment; otherwise write manually.
unknowns: Current report drafting and review effort
research_questions: Does complete-report timing show a net gain after every uncertainty and attribution is checked?

already_counted.description: Investigation direction and verified source pack

incremental.description: Maintain report structures and review drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact report text, evidence references, uncertainty statements and recipient; edits require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gross10 minus3 upkeep =7 net E1. High needs straightforward report assembly; low assumes corrections remove gross gain while upkeep remains.

steps.what: Verify changes needed in required maps and records
Enter checked changes into maintained maps and records
Check map locations, record content and access before releasing the revision

tasks.design: Configure existing {OPS_SYSTEM} records and {DOCS} revision controls to reuse stable locations and remove duplicate entry. Keep verification of real changes and the final map-location check; no automatic site mapping is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same checked change may be entered in several maintained views.
tasks.enabler_now: Native shared records and revisioned views can reduce repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: A valid coordinate or identifier can still refer to the wrong physical feature.
tasks.human_edge: Confirm that the record describes the actual site.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated record entry, with source and location checks unchanged.

reach.task: Validate site features and map revisions

evidence.claim: Reusing checked record changes across native views may reduce duplicate entry; no measured map-maintenance result is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary is required map and record maintenance, excluding physical surveying and the original site inspection.

Supervisor produces feature or record id, verified location, changed attributes, effective date and source reference in s1's full50 hours. If an id or location is missing, manual verification remains before transfer.
Existing site owners produce original change notices with unchanged capture effort; no new structured survey is transferred. Entry exceptions remain18 hours in s2 and final checks20 hours.
Test native shared fields and views before code; existing storage and rendering runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Can one checked update populate all required views without location or version ambiguity?

already_counted.description: Resolve entry exceptions and check reused fields

incremental.description: Review field definitions and revision exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact feature locations, attributes, source references and revision snapshot; changes void release approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88 gross12 minus4 upkeep =8 net E1. High needs duplicate entry; low covers unique site changes or already shared views.

steps.what: Collect coverage needs, employee availability and assignment constraints
Schedule employee work assignments against coverage and qualification constraints
Set work priorities, resolve conflicts and approve the final schedule

tasks.design: Configure a native rule-based scheduler in {OPS_SYSTEM} using checked availability, qualifications and coverage requirements. The supervisor resolves conflicts, sets work priorities and approves the schedule; no behavioural ranking is used.
tasks.previous_blocker: Constructing a feasible roster can require repeated constraint checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Scheduling software supports hard and soft workforce constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected absence and operational demands can invalidate a feasible roster.
tasks.human_edge: Balance readiness, fairness and immediate priorities.
tasks.altitude: Less roster construction, with priority decisions unchanged.

evidence.claim: ORTEC Workforce generates schedules using labour-law and collective-agreement constraints with final planner control.
The proposed fire-supervisor scheduling savings are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is advance work scheduling and priorities, excluding live incident command and employee work execution.

Employees and HR retain existing availability and qualification capture. Supervisor produces checked employee ids, dates, hours, required roles, coverage levels and constraint versions in s1's full30 hours. Missing inputs require manual confirmation.
Candidate verification and unsatisfied constraints remain18 hours in s2; priorities and final acceptance remain25 hours in s3.
Test native deterministic scheduling first; no productivity or personal-trait score is used. Additional rule maintenance is counted below.
unknowns: Current scheduling system and constraint quality
research_questions: Does rule-based construction save time after all availability and readiness exceptions are resolved?

already_counted.description: Check candidate schedule and resolve construction exceptions
Set priorities and accept final assignments

approvals.approved_version: Exact employees, assignments, hours, qualification snapshot and work priorities; revisions require renewed acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R73 gross27 minus5 upkeep =22 net E1. High needs manual constraint-heavy roster construction; low covers an existing scheduler or frequent last-minute changes.

tasks.short: Create fire safety guidance and evacuation schemes

steps.what: Establish building constraints and requirements for fire safety guidelines and evacuation schemes
Draft guidance and evacuation scheme text with the building's responsible participants

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory text from verified building decisions
loop.input: Verified requirements, participant decisions and approved outline
loop.output: Draft guidance with source links and unresolved questions
loop.check: Supervisor checks every instruction against the building plan, agreed scheme and occupant needs; no route or safety conclusion may be invented
loop.stop: One revision; unclear route, unsupported requirement or conflicting instruction returns to joint manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed templates organise the document but explanations vary by building

steps.what: Review guidance and evacuation schemes with responsible building participants

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} safety templates, with an optional bounded loop for explanatory text grounded in verified building decisions. Keep site interpretation and joint review human; the tool neither designs escape routes nor certifies the building.
tasks.previous_blocker: Site-specific decisions need to be expressed clearly in usable guidance.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates and constrained drafting can assist document preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Instructions must fit actual layout, occupancy and responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise unsafe assumptions and resolve them with responsible participants.
tasks.altitude: Less prose assembly, with safety judgement and participation unchanged.

reach.learn: Occupant needs and scheme review procedures

evidence.claim: Source-grounded drafting may reduce explanatory prose assembly; no measured safety-guidance result is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's contribution to creating guidance, excluding building alterations, formal certification and other participants' work.

Building manager supplies existing plans and occupant information. Supervisor verifies versions, observed constraints, agreed decisions and source requirements in s1's full40 hours; missing facts trigger joint clarification.
Any discussion required to establish participant decisions is included in s1; text checks remain21 hours in s2 and joint review25 hours in s3.
Native templates come first. No automatic route generation or new uncounted building survey is assumed.
research_questions: Does drafting assistance preserve every agreed instruction after building-specific review is timed?

already_counted.description: Verify building requirements and participant decisions

incremental.description: Maintain guidance structure and review drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact supervisor contribution, building plan version, agreed decisions and guidance text; changes require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gross14 minus4 upkeep =10 net E1. High needs settled decisions and repeated prose assembly; low covers complex buildings requiring full manual drafting.
